dialogues.jp: ひとしきり思い出した後、俺はことりを見た。
dialogues.en:
After lapsing into memory-land for awhile, I snap back to
reality and looked at Kotori.
dialogues.text:
After lapsing into memory-land for awhile, I snap back to
reality and looked at Kotori.

dialogues.jp: 「ほら、覚えてないか？　あの、クリス──」
dialogues.en: "Aw, don't you remember? The Chris--"
dialogues.text: "Aw, don't you remember? The Chris--"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ああ、はい、クリスマスパーティーの時の」
dialogues.en: "Oh yes! During the Christmas party."
dialogues.text: "Oh yes! During the Christmas party."

dialogues.jp: 言い終わる前に、ことりがぱんと手を叩いた。
dialogues.en:
Before I could finish my sentence, Kotori clapped her hands
together.
dialogues.text:
Before I could finish my sentence, Kotori clapped her hands
together.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「名乗るほどの者ではないさん♪」
dialogues.en: "Nameless-san♪"
dialogues.text: "Nameless-san♪"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「う……良くそこまで覚えてるな」
dialogues.en: "Uuh...looks like you really do remember."
dialogues.text: "Uuh...looks like you really do remember."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「記憶力には自信があるんですよ」
dialogues.en: "I have confidence in my memory."
dialogues.text: "I have confidence in my memory."

dialogues.jp: びしっと、親指を立ててみせる。
dialogues.en: Kotori gave a thumbs-up.
dialogues.text: Kotori gave a thumbs-up.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「でも、何であの時、名前を教えてくれなかっ
　たんですか？」
dialogues.en: "But, why were you so reluctant to tell me your name then?"
dialogues.text: "But, why were you so reluctant to tell me your name then?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「一時的な記憶喪失に陥ってな」
dialogues.en: "I fell into a memory lapse for an hour."
dialogues.text: "I fell into a memory lapse for an hour."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「それは大変でしたね……」
dialogues.en: "That's horrible..."
dialogues.text: "That's horrible..."

dialogues.jp: なんか……ことりって、冗談が通じない？
dialogues.en: I guess... she didn't get the joke?
dialogues.text: I guess... she didn't get the joke?

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「う〜……。こんなにはぐらかされるなんて、
　もしかして、教えたくない……？」
dialogues.en:
"Maaan... does this mean you won't tell me your name now
either?"
dialogues.text:
"Maaan... does this mean you won't tell me your name now
either?"

dialogues.jp: 別にそう言うわけじゃないんだが……。
dialogues.en: Don't say it like that....
dialogues.text: Don't say it like that....

dialogues.jp: ま、隠す必要なんてないんだよな。
dialogues.en: Well, no point in hiding it now.
dialogues.text: Well, no point in hiding it now.

dialogues.jp: 「朝倉。朝倉[name]」
dialogues.en: "Asakura. Asakura [name]."
dialogues.text: "Asakura. Asakura [name]."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉君ですね」
dialogues.en: "So that would be Asakura-kun."
dialogues.text: "So that would be Asakura-kun."

dialogues.jp: また、びしっと親指を立てる。
dialogues.en: Once again, her thumb went up.
dialogues.text: Once again, her thumb went up.

dialogues.jp: 「で、白河ことり」
dialogues.en: "And in my case, Shirakawa Kotori,"
dialogues.text: "And in my case, Shirakawa Kotori,"

dialogues.jp: 真似して、びしっと親指を立てた。
dialogues.en: Mimicking her, I gave her a thumbs up as well.
dialogues.text: Mimicking her, I gave her a thumbs up as well.

dialogues.jp:
「ことりって呼ばせてもらって、いいんだった
　よな？」
dialogues.en: "It's okay if I just call you Kotori, right?"
dialogues.text: "It's okay if I just call you Kotori, right?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ええ……くちゅん」
dialogues.en: "Ah...ah.... choo!"
dialogues.text: "Ah...ah.... choo!"

dialogues.jp: ふるふる、とことりが身体を震わせる。
dialogues.en: Kotori's body shivered slightly.
dialogues.text: Kotori's body shivered slightly.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「ずっと歌っていたから、身体が冷えてしまっ
　たみたいです」
dialogues.en:
"I've been singing here so long, I forgot about how cold it
was."
dialogues.text:
"I've been singing here so long, I forgot about how cold it
was."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「それじゃ、私はこれで失礼しますね」
dialogues.en: "I guess I'd be taking my leave now."
dialogues.text: "I guess I'd be taking my leave now."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「あら。もう、歌は終わり？」
dialogues.en: "Aw, the song's over?"
dialogues.text: "Aw, the song's over?"

dialogues.jp:
綺麗な歌声だったから、もうちょっと聴いてい
たかったけど。
dialogues.en:
I wanted to continue listening to such a beautiful singing
voice.
dialogues.text:
I wanted to continue listening to such a beautiful singing
voice.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「ごめんなさい……人が居ると、ちょっと。気
　になっちゃうから……」
dialogues.en:
"I'm sorry... I don't really like to sing when I know people
are around..."
dialogues.text:
"I'm sorry... I don't really like to sing when I know people
are around..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「そっか。なら仕方ない」
dialogues.en: "Oh well, in that case, it can't be helped."
dialogues.text: "Oh well, in that case, it can't be helped."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ではでは。さよならです」
dialogues.en: "Well then, farewell!"
dialogues.text: "Well then, farewell!"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ん。じゃあね」
dialogues.en: "Mm, later."
dialogues.text: "Mm, later."

dialogues.jp:
鼻をすんすんいわせながら、ことりは去っていっ
た。
dialogues.en: Lightly rubbing her nose, Kotori left the area.
dialogues.text: Lightly rubbing her nose, Kotori left the area.

dialogues.jp: 「……俺も帰るか」
dialogues.en: "...Guess I'd go home too."
dialogues.text: "...Guess I'd go home too."

dialogues.jp: ◆ことり、思い出す◆
dialogues.en: ◆Kotori Remembers◆
dialogues.text: ◆Kotori Remembers◆

dialogues.jp:
どうやら俺のことを完全に忘れてしまったわけ
ではないらしい。
dialogues.en: In the end, she didn't completely forget about me.
dialogues.text: In the end, she didn't completely forget about me.

dialogues.jp:
少し会話を交わすと、俺がクリスマスの時に会っ
た人物だと思い出してくれた。
dialogues.en:
After a bit of prodding, I manage to stir up the memories of
last Christmas inside her again.
dialogues.text:
After a bit of prodding, I manage to stir up the memories of
last Christmas inside her again.

dialogues.jp:
だが、少しだけ喋ると、身体が冷えたと言って、
ことりは去っていった。
dialogues.en:
But after a bit more chatter, with her body shivering,
Kotori went back home.
dialogues.text:
But after a bit more chatter, with her body shivering,
Kotori went back home.
